parsed.explanation: No trans-specific border, facility or custody exposure is documented, and same-sex criminalisation is a secondary factor, so this is not in the 0.15-0.25 organised-targeting tier. However the 2026 overview confirms Articles 520/517 still carry up to 3 years and reach a trans visitor regardless of marker, LGBTI organisations cannot register, and there is no anti-discrimination recourse. State raids in 2010 show the statute was used as a police lever against private gatherings; no later raid is documented, so current frequency is dated and uncertain, not proven ended. Whispered social life, fake-account activism, political endorsement of harsher punishment including stoning talk, and documented beatings/torture and claimed executions by armed groups show hostile society and non-state violence with no remedy. Extrapolating from criminalisation, banned organisation and no relief in a thin dossier gives severe consequences if outed, with inadequate protection: around 0.34.
